product_metadata.title: Triple Insulated Stainless Steel Vacuum Insulated Wine Bottle -24-hour Temperature Retention- 750ml Wine Canteen Made of Shatter Proof 18/8 Stainless Steel, BPA FREE Lids, Perfect for Travel & Picnic
features: Double-Wall Insulated - Bottle is 750ml, made of advanced vacuum-insulated drinkware technology to ensure your drink maintains the precise temperature you wish it to have whether hot or cold. It is sweatproof and won’t burn your hand of contents.

Durable and Unbreakable – Crafted of eco-friendly, premium 18/8 stainless steel. Completely shatterproof, it replaces those impossibly fragile glass bottles for glass-free zones and child-attended events. In addition, it’s odor, smudge, and rust resistant.

BPA-Free Insulated Lid– Bottle Is 100% leakproof and keeps flies out of your drink. It’s a great choice for outdoor entertaining or traveling. Whether you’re out boating, camping, at the pool or at the beach, take it along for an optimum drinking experience.

Ergonomically Designed– Bottle mimics the shape of a glass wine bottle. Has an easy grip and fits any type of cup holder. The screw-top lid is entirely leak-free to prevent spills and messes, and the sliding lid is designed for pleasant sipping through lips or straw.

The Perfect Gift - Set comes in an attractive gift box, effecting in an impressive gift for a wine connoisseur for any event such as a birthday, wedding, Christmas, or Thanksgiving. Includes a funnel for easy refilling and a cleaning brush, ensuring they enjoy your gift for many happy years
